annotations.text: A domain model revised across the *taxonomy* of inning outcomes — not one disposition repeated but four distinct ones, each a Peircean mode. 'Every swan is white' is audited against M: induction observes Ciel and leaps to the law; the law then covers a new swan (deduction over an inductive generalization — G stays TRUE where a bare tally would flip); abduction meets the black swan and relinquishes the over-general law. The taxonomy of game outcomes (docs/ENDOPOREUTIC_GAME_GUIDE.md) made operational.

Each step is a model-revising disposition from src/model_revision.py's REVISION_TAXONOMY: new_fact (3a, induction · enlargement), generalization (Case 8, induction · a law), challenge_to_M (2b, abduction · relinquish the law by a genuine Dau ERA + admit the anomaly). Enlargement is INS at the sheet; relinquishment is ERA in the positive sheet — the same calculus that draws every other graph.
M0 (the opening record): 'every swan is white' peels to FALSE — Ciel's colour is unrecorded.
M1: 'every swan is white' peels to TRUE (after new_fact · induction).
M2: 'every swan is white' peels to TRUE (after generalization · induction).
M3: 'every swan is white' peels to TRUE (after new_fact · induction).
M4: 'every swan is white' peels to FALSE (after challenge_to_M · abduction).
